scope: Descriptive analysis of four completed both-pass pairs, not the whole campaign or a randomized retry comparison. The prepared_seconds field times the bridge after its file lock: uncached encoding, artifact writes, catalog update, and refresh including draining active requests. It is preparation/publication wall time, not isolated encoder CPU time. It excludes outer publication-lock waiting, bridge-lock waiting, source capture/replay, tokenization, SSH overhead, and grading. Encoding artifacts can be reused; publication still has refresh costs. Agent time excludes acquisition. Adding the bridge timer to agent time is still not complete end-to-end accounting. API prompt/completion tokens do not measure native attention memory occupancy.
supersedes_scope_of: four-successful-pairs.json; numeric measurements and underlying archive are unchanged
